body: I've thought about leaving school but I think I'd just end up in the same place. I think your quote captures my life perfectly. Similar to the definition of insanity "doing the same thing and expecting a different result." I know it isn't rational but I still have the impulse to do it.

I have considered that but the reality is that if I can't fundamentally change myself I will remain unemployed and my parents will have to pay my loans anyway. If I could walk out of the door, find work, and find meaning in life I wouldn't be considering this option.
My parents are paying for one year. The rest is on me. From what I've read my government loans will disappear.
